Critical Uncertainties and Gaps in the Environmental- and Social-Impact Assessment of the Proposed Interoceanic Canal through Nicaragua
abstract: The proposed interoceanic canal will connect the Caribbean Sea with the Pacific Ocean, traversing Lake Nicaragua, the major freshwater reservoir in Central America. If completed, the canal would be the largest infrastructure-related excavation project on Earth. In November 2015, the Nicaraguan government approved an environmental and social impact assessment (ESIA) for the canal. A group of international experts participated in a workshop organized by the Academy of Sciences of Nicaragua to review this ESIA. The group concluded that the ESIA does not meet international standards; essential information is lacking regarding the potential impacts on the lake, freshwater and marine environments, and biodiversity. The ESIA presents an inadequate assessment of natural hazards and socioeconomic disruptions. The panel recommends that work on the canal project be suspended until an appropriate ESIA is completed. The project should be resumed only if it is demonstrated to be economically feasible, environmentally acceptable, and socially beneficial.
abstract_zh: 拟建的洲际运河将连接加勒比海与太平洋，穿过中美洲最大的淡水水库尼加拉瓜湖。若建成，该运河将成为地球上规模最大的基础设施开挖工程。2015年11月，尼加拉瓜政府批准了该运河的环境与社会影响评估（ESIA）。一个国际专家小组参加了由尼加拉瓜科学院组织的研讨会，以审查该ESIA。该小组认为，该ESIA不符合国际标准；关于运河对湖泊、淡水及海洋环境和生物多样性的潜在影响，缺乏关键信息。该ESIA对自然灾害和社会经济扰动的评估也不充分。专家小组建议，在完成适当的ESIA之前暂停运河工程。只有在证明该项目经济可行、环境可接受且社会有益的前提下，才应恢复该项目。

title: Opportunities for advances in climate change economics
abstract: There have been dramatic advances in understanding the physical science of climate change, facilitated by substantial and reliable research support. The social value of these advances depends on understanding their implications for society, an arena where research support has been more modest and research progress slower. Some advances have been made in understanding and formalizing climate-economy linkages, but knowledge gaps remain [e.g., as discussed in (1, 2)]. We outline three areas where we believe research progress on climate economics is both sorely needed, in light of policy relevance, and possible within the next few years given appropriate funding: (i) refining the social cost of carbon (SCC), (ii) improving understanding of the consequences of particular policies, and (iii) better understanding of the economic impacts and policy choices in developing economies.
abstract_zh: 在可靠且获得大量支持的研究资助推动下，人们对气候变化物理科学的认识取得了显著进展。这些进展的社会价值，取决于人们对其社会影响的理解，而在这一领域，研究资助相对较少，研究进展也较为缓慢。在理解和形式化气候与经济之间的联系方面已取得一些进展，但仍存在知识空白[例如（1，2）中所讨论的]。鉴于政策相关性，并假设获得适当资助，我们概述了三个领域，我们认为这些领域的气候经济学研究进展既迫切需要，又有望在未来几年内实现：（i）完善社会碳成本（SCC）的估算；（ii）增进对特定政策后果的理解；以及（iii）更好地理解发展中经济体的经济影响和政策选择。

abstract: This paper explores the welfare costs associated with drought plan transactions between a public municipal water agency, the El Dorado Irrigation District (EID) in California in the USA and its customers. The EID imposes a tiered pricing plan for municipal customers, which was analyzed as a discrete continuous choice (DCC) model by water users within a climate driven water evaluation and planning (WEAP) model of the EID water system. The DCC is subsequently used to estimate the compensating variation (CV) measure of the loss of consumer welfare in the case where a customer does not receive water that matches a preferred level of demand. In addition to monetized welfare loss, we look at other metrics of performance such as reservoir storage and hydropower generation. For the drought-of-record under full build-out, results show that the welfare loss to EID customers from the imposed drought plan is far less than if no drought plan were in place. This suggests that current consumption is well beyond essential needs and, without a drought plan, water shortages in the later period of a drought would generate a much greater welfare loss. Most of the cost associated with the drought plan is born by EID in the form of reduced revenues.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了加利福尼亚州一家市政供水机构——埃尔多拉多灌溉区（El Dorado Irrigation District，EID）与其用户之间，干旱应急计划交易所涉及的福利成本。EID对市政用户实行分档定价计划，该计划在EID供水系统的气候驱动水资源评估与规划（WEAP）模型中，被作为用户层面的离散—连续选择（DCC）模型进行分析。随后，利用DCC估算客户未获得符合其偏好用水量的供水时，消费者福利损失的补偿变化（CV）。除货币化的福利损失外，我们还考察了水库蓄水量和水电发电量等其他绩效指标。在全面建设情景下，对于历史记录中最严重的干旱（drought-of-record），结果显示，所实施的干旱计划给EID用户造成的福利损失，远小于未实施干旱计划的情况。这表明当前的消费水平远超基本需求，若没有干旱计划，干旱后期的水资源短缺将造成大得多的福利损失。干旱计划相关的成本大部分由EID以收入减少的形式承担。

title: Climate Change, Energy and Social Preferences on Policies: Exploratory Evidence for Spain
abstract: Spain faces a complex situation regarding its climate change policies. On the one hand, greenhouse gas emissions have shown an important increase since 1990, being far from the Kyoto commitments. On the other hand, Spain is likely to suffer important impacts from climate change. However, there has been a rather limited application of corrective policies, particularly in the field of energy prices. Indeed, although Spanish citizens generally show a large concern towards climate change, price increases in energy goods have been traditionally opposed. In this paper we try to offer an explanation to this phenomenon, and a possible hint for future policies in the field, by showing how Spanish households strongly favour the application of a green electricity program that makes electricity more expensive to reduce carbon dioxide emissions. In particular, with data from a phone survey representative of the Spanish population, the mean willingness to pay per month and household is 29.91€ over the current electric bill. Our results also show that younger individuals who live in the Mediterranean area are more likely to pay for this green electricity program.
abstract_zh: 西班牙在气候变化政策方面面临复杂局面。一方面，自1990年以来温室气体排放量大幅增长，远未达到《京都议定书》的承诺。另一方面，西班牙很可能遭受气候变化的重大影响。然而，纠正性政策的应用相当有限，尤其是在能源价格领域。事实上，尽管西班牙公民普遍高度关注气候变化，但能源商品价格的上涨一直遭到反对。本文试图对这一现象作出解释，并为该领域未来政策提供可能的启示：展示西班牙家庭如何强烈支持一项绿色电力计划，该计划通过使电力更加昂贵来减少二氧化碳排放。具体而言，利用一项具有西班牙人口代表性的电话调查数据，每户家庭每月的平均支付意愿为在现有电费基础上增加29.91欧元。我们的结果还表明，居住在地中海地区的年轻人更有可能为该绿色电力计划付费。

Cap-and-Trade: A Sufficient or Necessary Condition for Emission Reduction?
abstract: Influenced by the success of emission trading in the US for sulphur dioxide (SO2), some economists have argued for an upstream, economy-wide cap-and-trade scheme as the primary tool for achieving the required reduction in greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. This paper addresses that argument and concludes that cap-and-trade will need to be accompanied by complementary regulatory measures. While it is a necessary component in a climate mitigation programme, it is unlikely to be sufficient by itself to accomplish the desired emission reductions. The paper reviews the evidence on how SO2 emissions were reduced and the extent to which actual emission trading was responsible for the reduction as opposed to other innovations. It also identifies differences between the past regulation of SO2 and other air pollutants and the challenges presented by the regulation of GHG emissions. What actually happened in the US with SO2 emission trading deviated in several significant respects from what would be predicted based on the conventional theoretical analysis. While there was a dramatic reduction in SO2 emissions, it occurred because of several factors, some of which are unlikely to apply for GHG emissions, and others of which argue for an activist regulatory policy by the government as a complement to the functioning of an emissions market for GHGs.
abstract_zh: 受美国二氧化硫（SO2）排放交易成功经验的影响，一些经济学家主张采用上游的全经济体总量控制与交易机制，作为实现温室气体（GHG）减排目标所需的主要工具。本文针对这一论点，得出结论：总量控制与交易需要辅以配套的监管措施。尽管它是气候减缓方案的必要组成部分，但其本身不太可能足以实现预期的减排目标。本文回顾了美国SO2排放减少的证据，以及排放交易在多大程度上（而非其他创新）促成了这一减排。本文还指出了以往对SO2及其他大气污染物的监管与温室气体监管所面临挑战之间的差异。美国SO2排放交易的实际情况，在若干重要方面偏离了基于传统理论分析的预期。尽管SO2排放大幅减少，但这是多种因素共同作用的结果，其中一些因素不太可能适用于温室气体排放，而另一些因素则表明，政府需要采取积极的监管政策，以补充温室气体排放市场的运行。

The Role of Emission Trading in Domestic Climate Policy
abstract: This paper focuses on two specific issues in the design of a domestic cap and trade program for GHGs - whether the cap should be located upstream or downstream, and whether trading alone will suffice to achieve the desired reduction in GHGs or will need to be supplemented with additional regulatory measures. The paper argues for a downstream cap accompanied by measures such as a renewable portfolio standard, efficiency standards for vehicles, appliances and buildings, and a low carbon fuel standard. For this argument, it is necessary to address both the theory and the empirical evidence of emission trading. After reviewing the theory, the paper examines the actual experience in the U.S. with emission trading for SO2, to see whether the assumptions used in the theory actually applied in practice. What actually happened deviated in several important respects from what was supposed to happen according to the conventional theorizing. The design of a cap and trade program for GHG is then discussed, first considering the similarities between the past regulation of air pollutants and the challenge posed by GHGs, and then making the case for a downstream cap and complementary policies.
abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于国内温室气体总量控制与交易方案设计中的两个具体问题：总量控制应设于上游还是下游，以及仅靠交易能否实现温室气体减排目标，还是需要辅以额外的监管措施。本文主张采用下游总量控制，并辅以可再生能源配额制、车辆、家电和建筑的能效标准，以及低碳燃料标准等措施。要支持这一论点，必须同时探讨排放交易的理论与经验证据。在回顾理论之后，本文考察了美国SO2排放交易的实际经验，以检验理论假设在实践中是否成立。实际情况在若干重要方面偏离了传统理论所预期的结果。随后讨论了温室气体总量控制与交易的设计：首先考虑以往大气污染物监管与温室气体所带来挑战之间的相似之处，然后论证下游总量控制与配套政策的合理性。

California's New Greenhouse Gas Laws
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Since 2004, California has taken a variety of measures to control greenhouse gas emissions. This culminated in August 2006 with the passage of AB 32, which requires that overall GHG emissions in California be reduced to their 1990 levels by 2020; SB 1368, which prohibits California utilities from signing new long-term baseload power contracts with emissions higher than those from combined-cycle natural gas; and SB 107, which requires 20 percent of California's electricity to come from renewables by 2010. This article describes how California's GHG laws came to be enacted, why they took the form that they did, and how they differ from the approaches to pollution control adopted by the federal government in the 1990 Clean Air Act and the northeastern states in the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative. California's approach grows directly out of its prior, and rather unique, history in controlling automobile emissions and in regulating energy efficiency. Moreover, its approach reflects an awareness of some differences between GHG emissions and SO2 and NOx emissions, which are important for the design of a GHG control policy.
abstract_zh: 自2004年以来，加利福尼亚州采取了多项措施控制温室气体排放。这些措施在2006年8月达到高潮，当时通过了AB 32法案，要求加州温室气体排放总量到2020年降至1990年水平；通过了SB 1368法案，禁止加州的公用事业公司签订新的长期基荷电力合同，其排放量须高于联合循环天然气发电的排放水平；还通过了SB 107法案，要求到2010年加州20%的电力来自可再生能源。本文描述了加州温室气体法律是如何出台的，它们为何采取当前的形式，以及它们与联邦政府在1990年《清洁空气法》中以及东北部各州在《区域温室气体倡议》（Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative）中所采取的污染控制方法有何不同。加州的做法直接源于其此前颇为独特的历史，即在控制汽车排放和监管能源效率方面的经验。此外，其做法体现了对温室气体排放与二氧化硫和氮氧化物排放之间若干差异的认识，而这些差异对于温室气体控制政策的设计十分重要。

abstract: We estimate the price elasticity of water demand with household-level data, structurally modeling the piecewise-linear budget constraints imposed by increasing-block pricing. We develop a mathematical expression for the unconditional price elasticity of demand under increasing-block prices and compare conditional and unconditional elasticities analytically and empirically. We test the hypothesis that price elasticity may depend on price structure, beyond technical differences in elasticity concepts. Due to the possibility of endogenous utility price structure choice, observed differences in elasticity across price structures may be due either to a behavioral response to price structure, or to underlying heterogeneity among water utility service areas.
abstract_zh: 我们利用家庭层面数据估计水需求的价格弹性，对递增阶梯定价所施加的分段线性预算约束进行结构化建模。我们推导出递增阶梯价格下无条件价格弹性的数学表达式，并在理论和实证上比较了条件弹性与无条件弹性。我们检验了如下假设：除弹性概念上的技术性差异外，价格弹性还可能取决于价格结构本身。由于供水公司可能内生地选择价格结构，不同价格结构下观察到的弹性差异，既可能源于对价格结构的行为反应，也可能源于供水服务区之间潜在的异质性。

abstract: We link farmland values to climatic, soil, and socioeconomic variables for U.S. counties east of the 100th meridian, the historical boundary of agriculture not primarily dependent on irrigation. Degree days, a nonlinear transformation of the climatic variables suggested by agronomic experiments as more relevant to crop yield, gives an improved fit and increased robustness. Estimated coefficients are consistent with the experimental results. The model is employed to estimate the potential impacts on farmland values for a range of recent warming scenarios. The predictions are very robust, and more than 75% of the counties in our sample show a statistically significant effect, ranging from moderate gains to large losses, with losses in the aggregate that can become quite large under scenarios involving sustained heavy use of fossil fuels.
abstract_zh: 我们将农田价格与美国第100经线以东县的气候、土壤和社会经济变量联系起来。第100经线是历史上不主要依赖灌溉的农业边界。度日是依据农学实验认为与作物单产更相关的、对气候变量的非线性变换，它使拟合效果更好且更稳健。估计系数与实验结果一致。该模型被用于估计一系列近期变暖情景下对农田价格的潜在影响。预测结果非常稳健，我们样本中超过75%的县显示出统计显著的效应，从温和收益到大幅损失不等，且在持续大量使用化石燃料的情景下，总体损失可能相当巨大。

abstract: While market approaches are clearly valuable for improving U.S. environmental policy, they cannot solve all of the problems, and not necessarily the most difficult ones. They can ensure that a given total abatement is achieved at minimum cost. But, if pollution damages depend on how abatement effort is allocated among polluters, this is not necessarily the most desirable outcome. One also needs to be sure that the potential gains from trade implicit in market solutions will actually be realized within some given time; the empirical evidence here is not necessarily promising. Rather than how aggregate abatement should be distributed among polluters, the chief difficulty often lies in determining how much overall abatement is required. A key factor that economists tend to overlook is the difficulty of ascertaining just how benefits vary with abatement effort. Uncertainty and risk aversion in connection with the marginal benefit curve may explain regulatory actions that are otherwise hard to justify.
abstract_zh: 尽管市场手段对于改善美国环境政策显然很有价值，但它们无法解决所有问题，而且未必能解决最困难的那些问题。市场能够确保以最低成本实现既定的总减排量。但如果污染损害取决于减排努力在各污染者之间的分配方式，那么这未必是最理想的结果。还需要确保市场解决方案中隐含的潜在贸易收益能够在某一给定时间内真正实现，而这方面的经验证据未必乐观。通常，最困难之处不在于如何在污染者之间分配总减排量，而在于确定总体需要多少减排量。经济学家往往忽视的一个关键因素，是难以确切弄清效益如何随减排努力而变化。与边际效益曲线相关的不确定性和风险厌恶，可能解释了一些在其他情况下难以证明合理的监管行动。

abstract: Contingent valuation is now used around the world to value many types of public goods, including transportation, sanitation, health, and education, as well as the environment. The author describes how researchers go about making such surveys reliable, mentioning recent innovations in sampling, questionnaire design, and data analysis, including formulating the valuation as a closed-ended question about voting in a referendum to raise taxes for a particular purpose. He addresses various objections that contingent valuation results are incompatible with economic theory. Even without a market, there still exists a latent demand curve for nonmarket goods; contingent valuation represents a way to tease this out.
abstract_zh: 条件价值评估法（Contingent valuation）目前已在全球范围内用于评估多种类型的公共物品，包括交通、卫生设施、健康和教育，以及环境。作者描述了研究人员如何使此类调查更为可靠，提到了抽样、问卷设计和数据分析方面的最新创新，包括将估值设计为关于为特定目的增税的全民公投投票的封闭式问题。他探讨了对条件价值评估结果与经济理论不相容的各种质疑。即使在没有市场的情况下，非市场商品依然存在潜在的需求曲线；条件价值评估法正是揭示这一需求曲线的一种方式。

abstract: With the advent of Executive Order 12291, policymakers involved in water quality regulation are increasingly interested in assessing the benefits of their programs. Several methods for valuing water quality improvements using recreational demand models have been developed by economists, most of which depend on observing recreationists visiting an array of sites with varying water quality and costs of access. In this paper, three general types of models are described: systems of demands, discrete choice models, and the hedonic travel cost approach; the latter two models are demonstrated using a common data set on water quality and swimming behavior in the Boston area. The models are contrasted and their relative usefulness in answering policy questions explored.
abstract_zh: 随着第12291号行政命令的颁布，参与水质监管的政策制定者日益关注评估其项目的效益。经济学家已开发出几种利用休闲需求模型评估水质改善的方法，其中大多数依赖于观察休闲者前往水质和获取成本各异的一系列地点的行为。本文描述了三类基本模型：需求系统、离散选择模型和享乐式旅行成本方法；后两类模型使用波士顿地区关于水质和游泳行为的一个共同数据集进行了演示。文中对这些模型进行了对比，并探讨了它们在回答政策问题方面的相对有用性。

title: Quasi-Option Value: Some Misconceptions Dispelled
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Time and the Recreational Demand Model
Environmental Damages and Option Values
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to clarify a concept — option value — that has arisen in environmental literature, to illustrate how it might be measured, and to indicate its potential importance. Option value arises when failure to control environmental disruption leads to irreversible losses of uncertain magnitude. We show that, even in the absence of risk aversion, replacing random variables representing benefits of control with their expected values results in an underestimate of benefits and that the required “correction factor” is option value. An example shows that option value can be substantial relative to conventionally estimated benefits (from 10 percent to over 50 percent in the example).
abstract_zh: 本文旨在厘清环境文献中出现的一个概念——期权价值（option value），说明如何对其进行度量，并指出其潜在的重要性。当未能控制环境破坏导致不可逆的、规模不确定的损失时，期权价值便会产生。我们表明，即使在不存在风险厌恶的情况下，若以期望值替代代表控制收益的随机变量，也会低估收益，而所需的“修正因子”正是期权价值。一个例子表明，相对于传统估算的收益，期权价值可能相当可观（在该例中为10%至50%以上）。

title: Some Issues in Continuous- and Discrete-Response Contingent Valuation Studies
Discrete/Continuous Models of Consumer Demand
Entropy as a Measure of Consensus in the Evaluation of Recreation Site Quality
Welfare Evaluations in Contingent Valuation Experiments with Discrete Responses
Marginal Welfare Measures for Discrete Choice Models
Measuring the Worth of Natural Resource Facilities
abstract: Techniques for assessing the worth of natural resources and determining the cost of development projects on the basis of a demand curve have error bounds besides those already described in the literature by Willig (1976) and by Bockstael and McConnell (1980), but Hanemann shows how these can be minimized. Bockstael and McConnell, in reply, question the use of consumer's surplus to measure the value of natural-resource facilities and point out the range of evidence from interested parties and the arbitrary assignment of rights. Outcome of benefit cost analysis can be defined only in terms of the assignment of rights. 8 references. (DCK)
abstract_zh: 基于需求曲线评估自然资源价值并确定开发项目成本的技术，除了Willig（1976）以及Bockstael与McConnell（1980）文献中已描述的误差范围外，还存在其他误差范围，但Hanemann表明了如何将其最小化。Bockstael与McConnell在回复中质疑了以消费者剩余衡量自然资源设施价值的做法，并指出了利益相关方所提供的各类证据，以及权利的任意分配问题。效益—成本分析的结果只能根据权利的分配来界定。参考文献8篇。（DCK）

title: Impact of Pollution Control Regulations on the Market Risk of Securities in the U. S.
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to examine the effects of the recent water and air pollution control legislation in the United States upon the market risk of the firms in the most directly affected industries, such as chemicals, electric utilities, iron and steel, petroleum, non‐ferrous metals and textiles, during the period 1953–75.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在考察美国近期水污染和大气污染控制立法对受影响最直接行业（如化工、电力公用事业、钢铁、石油、有色金属和纺织业）企业市场风险的影响，考察期为1953–1975年。
